name: Logisticfacts.shipmentcount equals shipments in range, tenant-scoped
note: Logisticfacts applies NO docstatus filter - every m_inout row is in scope, drafts and voided included. That is the cube's current definition and the reference mirrors it. Every join off m_inout is a LEFT JOIN to a single-row lookup, and the LATERAL price subquery is an aggregate returning one row, so nothing multiplies and the count is simply the number of m_inout rows.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM m_inout io WHERE io.ad_client_id=1000026 AND io.shipdate >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND io.shipdate < DATE '2026-09-01'
